messages.en:
{07 14 00}I may not look it,{01 00 00 05 00} but I am
a total {01 00 00 05 00}superhero when it
comes to hide-and-seek.
{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}{07 0b 00}What's that?{01 00 00 14 00} It looks to
me,{04 1f 00}, like you
don't believe me!
{07 14 00}In that case,{01 01 00} why don't we
play a game of hide-and-
seek and see who wins!!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma ei pruugi välja näha,{01 00 00 05 00} aga
olen peituse alal täielik
{01 00 00 05 00}superkangelane.
{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}{07 0b 00}Mis see on?{01 00 00 14 00} Mulle
tundub,{04 1f 00}, et sa
ei usu mind!
{07 14 00}Sel juhul{01 01 00} miks me ei
mängi peitust ja vaata,
kes võidab!!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00} Play
hide-n-seek with me,{01 00 00 05 00}
{04 02 00}!
{07 0d 00}Today{01 00 00 0a 00} I feel like hiding
